title: Identification of Novel Mutations in Arabidopsis thaliana DOF 4.2 Coding Gene.
authors: Jamshidi Kandjani, Omid; Rahbar-Shahrouziasl, Mahdieh; Alizadeh, Ali Akbar; Hamzeh-Mivehroud, Maryam; Dastmalchi, Siavoush
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟评估拟南芥DOF 4.2锌指结构域突变体对DNA结合亲和力的影响，聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法上采用MD模拟，对象为植物特异性转录因子，高度匹配课题。
abstract: Purpose: DOF (DNA-binding with One Finger) proteins are plant-specific transcription factors which mediate numerous biological processes. The purpose of the current study is to report new naturally occurring mutations in the gene encoding for one of the members of DOF proteins named DOF 4.2. Methods: The expression of zinc finger domain of DOF 4.2 (DOF 4.2-ZF) was investigated by first synthesis of cDNA library using different parts of Arabidopsis thaliana plant. Then the coding sequence for zinc finger domain of DOF 4.2 protein was prepared using nested PCR experiment and cloned into pGEX-6P-1 expression vector. Finally, the prepared construct was used for protein expression. Furthermore, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation was carried out to predict DNA binding affinity of DOF 4.2-ZF using AMBER package. Results: For the first time a new variant of DOF 4.2-ZF protein with three mutations was detected. One of the mutations is silent while the other two mutations lead to amino acid replacement (S18G) as well as introduction of a stop codon ultimately resulting in a truncated protein production. In order to investigate whether the truncated form is able to recognize DNA binding motif, MD simulations were carried out and the results showed that the chance of binding of DOF 4.2-ZF protein to cognate DNA in its truncated form is very low. Conclusion: The findings demonstrated that the observed mutations adversely affect the DNA binding ability of the truncated form of DOF4.2 if it is expressed in the mutant variant of A. thaliana used in this study.
abstract_zh: 目的：DOF（单指DNA结合）蛋白是植物特异性转录因子，介导多种生物过程。本研究旨在报告编码DOF蛋白成员之一DOF 4.2的基因中天然发生的新突变。方法：通过首先使用拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）不同部分合成cDNA文库，研究DOF 4.2锌指结构域（DOF 4.2-ZF）的表达。随后，利用巢式PCR实验制备DOF 4.2蛋白锌指结构域的编码序列，并克隆至pGEX-6P-1表达载体中。最后，使用所构建的载体进行蛋白表达。此外，利用AMBER软件包进行分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，以预测DOF 4.2-ZF的DNA结合亲和力。结果：首次检测到DOF 4.2-ZF蛋白的一个新变体，包含三个突变。其中一个突变为沉默突变，而另外两个突变导致氨基酸替换（S18G）以及引入终止密码子，最终产生截短蛋白。为探究截短形式是否能识别DNA结合基序，进行了MD模拟，结果表明，截短形式的DOF 4.2-ZF蛋白与同源DNA结合的概率非常低。结论：研究结果表明，在本研究使用的拟南芥突变变体中，观察到的突变对截短形式DOF 4.2的DNA结合能力产生不利影响（如果该形式被表达）。
